Best Vietnamese Restaurant Anywhere!
May 2026 • Couples
Without a doubt, this is the best Vietnamese restaurant in Saigon. It’s also one of our favorite restaurants anywhere. We dined here six times during our 2026 three-week stay in Saigon. We also dined here many times during our previous stays in the city. The spring roll appetizers are to die for. The dinners consisting of seafood, fish, chicken and/or beef are wonderful. The noodles are fabulous. Try the fried (flaming) bananas for desert. Tran Van Tuan, the restaurant’s manager, puts on a spectacular show as he prepares the flaming bananas and mango at your table. The wine list is extensive and the service excellent (thanks to Mai Thi Kim Chi, Hoang Khang, Kim Phuong, Thuong Quan and the others who helped). The ambience is wonderful. The restaurant has classy live Vietnamese and classical music. The restaurant is an A+.

We savored blissful Vietnamese court cuisine.
Mar 2026 • Couples
We went to Mandarine, which is loved by dignitaries from around the world♡ We enjoyed blissful Vietnamese court cuisine in the finest space.

Sing Chao. I went to Mandarin Restaurant, a famous restaurant I longed for, nestled in a back alley in District 1, Ho Chi Minh City.

Since its establishment in 1997, the hotel has been like a state guesthouse, which is also used at official events of the Vietnamese government. In the past, it has been famous that VIPs from around the world, such as His Majesty the Emperor of Japan (when he was Crown Prince), former Prime Minister Koizumi, and former President Clinton, have visited here.

Step inside and you'll find otherworldly☆nail-free construction of elaborate carved wood interiors and antique furniture, with a dignified atmosphere reminiscent of Hue's former court! This time we would like to introduce you to some of the exquisite dishes we have had in such a historic space.

We start with appetizers with the chef's recommended mark.

“Green Papaya Salad & Beef Jerky” is a Vietnamese classic street food, made into such a sophisticated dish with Mandarin magic...! The crunchy green papaya is paired with homemade beef jerky, which overflows with flavor the more you chew. This jerky is smoked using traditional methods and has a really rich aroma. Sweet and sour dressings of nucum and lime bring out the coolness of papaya.

The white shrimp crackers served with the dish are topped with salad and jerky and crunchy♡ You can enjoy the crispy, supple and juicy texture all at once, making it a great snack. Adult enjoyment is to choose this "conventional dish" in a prestigious place.

If you visit Mandarin, you must not miss these two types of fried Mandarin spring rolls and fresh spring rolls.

The Mandarin Fried Spring Roll is a golden triangle spring roll with a shrimp tail that pops out! This unusual shape enhances the crispness of the corners. Inside, there are jam-packed shrimp, pork and jellyfish. It uses a whole shrimp, so the contrast between the crispiness and the aroma is the best ☆ It is a meteoric dish.

Fresh spring rolls are a jewel-like beautiful plate of rice paper♡ Chewy yet crisp, exquisitely rehashed paper carefully wrapped with fresh herbs, shrimp and pork. A rich peanut-based miso sauce (Tương chấm) adds a lot of depth to the flavor. The carrot work (tower-shaped) attached to the side is also artistic and mesmerizing.

And the highlight of the day was this overly luxurious soup♡Eating aesthetics? The blissful soup "Crab and Swallow Nest Soup with Coconut" has an overwhelming presence! It is the ultimate medicinal and beauty soup, steamed with whole coconut as a vessel.

The Swallow's Nest, one of the world's top three delicacies, looks like this! It is so luxuriously used that the texture of the plump and the delicate taste of the crab combine to create a truly blissful taste. The subtle sweetness melted from coconut gently envelops the soup. The elegant taste of crab umami is concentrated in a luxurious feeling that fills the heart and skin. It was a perfect "eating aesthetic" as a reward for myself ♡

The Mandarin Restaurant is perhaps Ho Chi Minh City's most famous gastronomic destination worldwide, preserving tradition but adding a modern twist! There are many other dishes you might be interested in, such as "steamed emperor-style cod" and "steamed lotus leaf rice"! Make sure to book and visit for dinner with loved ones or special anniversaries.

It will be an unforgettable moment to decorate your Ho Chi Minh City night.

Thanks for the food.

Enjoy Ho Chi Minh Life

Amazing if you have a food allergy
Sep 2025 • Friends
We visited this evening with a large group of around 50 people for a tasting menu, and the experience was absolutely fantastic. Organizing a group this size is never easy, especially with so many different allergies and dietary requirements, but the team here handled everything flawlessly.
I personally have a nut and fish allergy, and I was blown away by how careful and attentive the staff were. They double-checked every detail, reassured me at each course, and even went out of their way to create something special so I didn’t miss out. It made the evening stress-free and incredibly enjoyable.
The food itself was delicious, beautifully presented, and full of authentic flavors. Every single person in our group left impressed and happy — no small feat with such a big party! The level of care, professionalism, and hospitality shown by the staff went far above our expectations.
I can’t recommend this restaurant highly enough — whether you’re dining as a couple, a family, or even a group of 50, they will look after you brilliantly. We’ll definitely be back!

Excellent food and service
Feb 2025 • Family
Mandarine Saigon really impressed me. 

The food selections were delicious and well presented. From the extensive menu we ordered prawns with vegetables, a vegetarian soup, tofu and roasted duck. All were tasty and I truly enjoyed each of them. 

The staff was friendly, helpful and all spoke English quite well. 

We were seated quickly on the top floor which was quiet and a beautiful setting. A large tour group was seated on the second floor but this had no effect on our experience. 

The only issue was that the air conditioning was too strong. 

Prices for our dishes was reasonable considering that we were in the tourist portion of district one.

An enchanting evening…….
Jan 2025 • Couples
We had been the night before to the Mandarine Restaurant for a set menu dinner which was very nice with our tour group, but being far more adventurous than set menus we decided to give the place another go. We were delighted with the result. We decided to share the dishes so we could try more - pancakes, spicey hot soup, banana flower salad, chilli oil beef, a prawn dish and the obligatory , for me anyway, steamed rice. We finished with flambéed banana (cooked at the table) served with coconut ice cream. 
A wonderful meal whilst being entertained by a classical trio (piano, violin & cello) who like the food, were excellent. 
I cannot speak highly enough about the quality of the food in texture and flavours served by attentive, professional and friendly staff. 
Thank you for an enchanted evening!
